description: Source code for a web component class 'TodoTopbar' that manages the top bar of a TodoMVC application, including input handling, display updates, and event dispatching.

classes.name: TodoTopbar
classes.description: Custom web component class extending HTMLElement, managing the top bar UI and interactions for a TodoMVC app.

methods.name: toggleAll
methods.description: Handles toggling all todo items as completed or not, dispatching 'toggle-all' event.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a new todo item, dispatching 'add-item' event with item details.

methods.name: updateDisplay
methods.description: Updates the visibility and state of toggle controls based on current item counts and route.

methods.name: updateRoute
methods.description: Sets the current route ('active', 'completed', or default) and updates display accordingly.

methods.name: addListeners
methods.description: Attaches event listeners for toggle input and key listeners.

methods.name: removeListeners
methods.description: Removes event listeners for toggle input and key listeners.

methods.name: attributeChangedCallback
methods.description: React to observed attribute changes and update display if connected.

methods.name: connectedCallback
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when element is added to DOM; initializes key listeners, display, and focus.

methods.name: disconnectedCallback
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when element is removed from DOM; cleans up event listeners.
